test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only six people sit to the right of C. Only four people sit to the left of B. D sits to the left of A but right of B. F sits second to the right of G. How many people sit to the right of E?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people, **A, B, C, D, E, F, G**, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only six people sit to the right of C.

Only four people sit to the left of B.

D sits to the left of A but right of B.

F sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e34accbedd9bb7e581aa3f29d4b28b3a66d3dbaa5098d1d9525663ea606cd56f.png] 

So, Number of people to the **right of E** = positions 4, 5, 6, 7 → 4 people

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
